about_the_game:
The Lurkers Pack lets you unleash the legends of the deep, with skins like Octo, Kraken, Scales, and Drake. Strike fear into the hearts of your opponents as you master the art of lurking in the shadows.

As you hunt the depths in high-flying torpedo combat, you’ll look like a legend with skins that give you mythical powers. Remember, Tidal Shock is free to play—never pay to win—so your style speaks for itself in this underwater adventure.

Support the Little Guys: By picking up this pack, you’re helping our small indie studio continue to innovate and deliver the unique experiences you crave!
